data.name: Akriti
data.gender_notes: Akriti is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Akriti is derived from the Sanskrit word 'akr' which means 'to do' or 'to make'. The suffix 'iti' means 'she who does'. This name signifies a skillful, expert, and intelligent woman. The name Akriti carries the meaning “Skillful, Expert, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Akriti usually hope their child will grow to embody skillful, expert, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner wisdom and courage of a woman.

in_sanskrit.name: अक्रिति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Akriti in Sanskrit is derived from the Sanskrit words 'akrit' which means 'boundless' and 'iti' which means 'this'. Thus, Akriti can be interpreted as 'this which is boundless' or 'the one who is boundless'. It can also be translated as 'limitless' or 'endless'.
